$comment: Source of truth for Decorator Machine ingredient art. Every asset records the prompt that made it, so any piece can be regenerated or restyled without guesswork. Full prompt = the family's promptTemplate with {subject} replaced. Essences are also described here, but their names, categories and emoji are read from DecoratorModels.swift at build time so the game catalogue stays authoritative.

families.label: Form
families.question: What is it?
families.blurb: The undecorated blank. Forms decide what the machine is building; everything else decides how it turns out.
families.promptTemplate: A {subject}, for a children's storybook game. Shown as a plain undecorated blank: {blank}, completely unpainted, no pattern, no print, no decoration of any kind, like an unpainted craft-store kit piece waiting to be decorated. Storybook illustration style, soft rounded shapes, thick clean dark outlines. Centered composition, the object fills most of the frame. Completely flat solid light gray background, absolutely no gradient, no drop shadow, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers.

families.label: Material
families.question: What is it made of?
families.blurb: Raw stuff, shown as a bare sample rather than made into anything. Materials carry the look and the feel of the finished piece.
families.promptTemplate: A raw material sample of {subject}, for a children's storybook game. Shown as a bare sample of the material on its own — a small neat stack, chunk or swatch — not built into any object. Storybook illustration style, soft rounded shapes, thick clean dark outlines, bright friendly colors. Centered composition, the sample fills most of the frame. Completely flat solid light gray background, absolutely no gradient, no drop shadow, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers.

families.label: Essence
families.question: How does it feel?
families.blurb: Bottled mood. Essences do not change what a thing is, only the feeling it gives off.
families.promptTemplate: A single whimsical glass potion bottle with a cork stopper, for a children's storybook game, containing {subject}. Storybook illustration style, soft rounded shapes, thick clean dark outlines, bright friendly colors. Centered composition, the bottle fills most of the frame. Completely flat solid light gray background, absolutely no gradient, no drop shadow, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers.

families.label: Enchantment
families.question: What does it do?
families.blurb: The trick the finished thing performs. This is where a couch becomes a couch that burps rainbows.
families.promptTemplate: A small round enamel charm medallion on a tiny ring, for a children's storybook game, its face illustrating {subject}. Storybook illustration style, soft rounded shapes, thick clean dark outlines, bright friendly colors, glossy enamel look. Centered composition, the charm fills most of the frame. Completely flat solid light gray background, absolutely no gradient, no drop shadow, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers.

families.label: Trim
families.question: What is the finishing touch?
families.blurb: Haberdashery. Optional, cheap to add, and the fastest way to make two otherwise identical pieces feel different.
families.promptTemplate: A haberdashery notion of {subject}, for a children's storybook game. Shown on its own as a neat coil, spool or sewing card, not attached to anything. Storybook illustration style, soft rounded shapes, thick clean dark outlines, bright friendly colors. Centered composition, the notion fills most of the frame. Completely flat solid light gray background, absolutely no gradient, no drop shadow, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers.
